svg.aria-label: From input statistics to the MCU-returned buffer
svg.text: From input statistics to the MCU-returned buffer
10% window, budget 24; historical LDF statistics and offline outputs, not live hardware frame capture.
Top: 0–255 input statistics. Bottom: 16-bit algorithm values. Different numeric domains are not screen nits.
APP raw/raw_apl is a global AW readback, not the zone peak shown here and not SPI electrical current.
